data.description:
THE LAST FRONTIER

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.

You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.

  • Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.

  • Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.

  • Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries.

  • Technical Expertise: Understand the architecture, dependencies, and technical challenges of hardware design and development. Support engineering teams in resolving technical issues. Ensure compliance with industry standards and government regulations, such as MIL-STD, UK DEFSTAN, and STANAG testing and qualification requirements across the product lifecycle.

  • Act as the connective tissue across engineering, procurement, business development, security, product, commercial, and customers — driving cross-functional alignment and ensuring technical progress, customer commitments, and delivery constraints are understood on all sides.

  • Identify and resolve blockers fast, escalate early and clearly, and provide concise, decision-ready updates on consequential tradeoffs.

  • Build and refine the project management tooling, processes, and reporting cadence as ARD scales — you'll be creating much of this from scratch.

  • Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans, and facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners.

  • Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or adjacent discipline - or - experience working in a technical engineering role prior to working as a project manager.

  • 4+ years proven experience in Technical Engineering Project Management across multiple concurrent projects,, delivering complex hardware products, ideally in defence, aerospace, or another regulated hardware environment; and ideally at a range of company maturity stages.

  • Working familiarity with MIL-STD testing standards, UK DEFSTAN, and NATO STANAG requirements, and how these shape project planning and qualification timelines.

  • Comfort operating across a range of TRL levels — from early, rapid prototyping and experimentation through to production-grade delivery — and judgement on how to flex process accordingly.

  • A genuine start-up mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, resourcefulness, and getting hands dirty where needed, rather than waiting for the perfect process.

  • A track record of hitting ambitious deadlines in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills — able to communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership.

  • Willingness to travel to remote and extreme environments as part of the role if deemed necessary.

DESIRABLE SKILLS

  • Knowledge of environmental and reliability testing (e.g. thermal cycling, vibration, shock)

  • Familiarity of electrical systems to ensure a holistic approach to hardware design

  • Basic understanding of RF systems and components

  • Previous experience working within an R&D workshop

  • Experience with satellite communications, RF hardware, or Arctic/extreme-environment systems.

  • Familiarity with export control considerations (ITAR/EAR, UK export licensing) relevant to dual-use technology.

  • Experience working with or alongside defence primes, MOD, or NATO procurement processes.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation

  • Equity: meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company

  • Private Healthcare for you and your family, including dental and optical

  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

  • Mission-driven culture: focus on impact, not hours logged

  • Small team, real ownership: what you build matters and ships

**Before you take time to apply, please note that at this timing unfortunately we are not able to sponsor a visa for this position**

A note on who we want to hear from
We're building for one of the most demanding environments on Earth and we believe diverse teams build more resilient systems. We actively welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in engineering - whether that's by gender, ethnicity, disability, or background. If you're not sure you meet every requirement, apply anyway and tell us what excites you about the problem.

About The Role

We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented team player to join FAIRR as an analyst within our Research and Data (R&D) team. In this role, you will be driving company-level research across our Protein Producer Index (PPI) and Seafood Index (SI). Our data-driven benchmarks help market participants to understand how companies are positioned to manage the risks and opportunities that lie within global food systems. In addition to owning a portfolio of companies, you will also be collaborating with FAIRR subject matter experts to develop sector and thematic research insights and feed into the product development cycle for our benchmarks. 


Key Outcomes & Accountabilities

  • ESG Data Analysis: Collect, analyse and score publicly available data and build a view on how companies manage material ESG risks and opportunities. Apply FAIRR’s methodology with accuracy and consistency, ensuring adherence to internal quality standards. 
  • Identification of ESG Risks, Opportunities and Trends: Translate raw data into actionable insights at the company level, highlighting emerging risks, opportunities, trends and progress relevant to food system sustainability. Draft structured outputs in different formats: summaries, data-driven reports, and briefing notes that are robust and well-evidenced. 
  • Company Dialogue: Lead constructive and informative conversations with companies during the research cycle, providing clear guidance to them on process, timelines, methodology and findings to support transparency and dialogue.

  • Stakeholder Support: Act as a key point of contact for investor members, the media and other external stakeholders seeking deeper insights into company scores and benchmark assessments. 
  • Expertise Development: Continually deepen your subject-matter expertise in global food systems and/or specific areas of our research methodologies. 
  • Continuous Improvement: Work on the frontline of our research, acting as a key source of feedback on how our methodologies, products, processes and technological systems can be evolved over time to better meet market needs.

This may include responding to research requests, supporting the preparation of investor and corporate engagement, contributing analytical input to briefings and documents, and supporting cross-functional initiatives.


Technical Expertise & Role-Specific Capability

  • Passionate about Sustainability – you want to deepen your understanding of the risks and opportunities that exist within our terrestrial and marine food systems today.
  • Excellent research and analytical skills—both qualitative and quantitative—with strong attention to detail. Ability to identify relevant trends in large data sets and derive conclusions based on the analysis. 
  • Fluency in spoken and written English. Ability to draft written materials to a professional standard with minimal review and excellent verbal communications skills 
  • Strong project management skills, including an ability to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. 
  • Demonstrable experience of interacting and working with senior business professionals.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We are hiring our first dedicated Recruiter for GTM Expansion, based in London: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who will outperform their peers and run a full-cycle process that wins them.

The UK is the immediate mandate. You will partner with local and US-based leaders to turn an ambitious growth plan into a real commercial team, from first conversation through offer close. You will also help us build the recruiting approach, market knowledge and candidate networks that support Ramp's expansion into new GTM markets over time.

The recruiters who do this best combine craft on the front end, research, identification and calibration, with execution on the back end, closing, candidate experience and pipeline discipline. We are looking for both.

What You'll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for priority GTM Expansion hiring, starting with UK roles across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships and Customer Success.

• Build a sharp point of view on the UK market and future expansion markets: the companies producing strong talent, the people who outperform their peers and the communities that matter.

• Use research, data and AI as part of your everyday craft to identify and qualify exceptional candidates. We expect a written market point of view, not just a slate of profiles.

• Run thoughtful, personalised outreach grounded in the candidate's actual background, commercial motion or recent work. We care more about quality, replies and conversion than send volume.

• Partner with GTM leaders to turn ambitious hiring plans into a clear profile, credible process and realistic compensation strategy. Surface hard market truth early and push back constructively when needed.

• Own the candidate experience from first conversation through offer close: fast follow-up, clear communication, strong process discipline and a tailored closing plan for the candidates we most want.

• Build real presence for Ramp in London through the right relationships, referrals and targeted community activity. The point is pipeline and credibility, not events for their own sake.

• Work tightly with the wider GTM Recruiting team on calibration, sourcing support, insight and operating rhythm, while bringing strong local judgment.

• Help improve how Ramp recruits for expansion by capturing what works in the UK and applying it thoughtfully as we enter new markets.

What You Need

• 5+ years of full-cycle GTM or Sales recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology company where quality and pace both mattered.

• Strong knowledge of the UK technology talent market and a credible local network, or clear evidence that you can build one quickly.

• A track record of finding and closing exceptional people, not simply running inherited processes. You can point to candidates you identified who became strong hires.

• Excellent sourcing and research instincts. You can explain why someone is genuinely differentiated, not only that they have the right title at the right company.

• Experience hiring across several GTM functions, such as AEs, Sales Leadership, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships, Customer Success or RevOps.

• Strong candidate-closing judgment. You listen closely, understand what each candidate is weighing and can build conviction against serious alternatives.

• The confidence to influence senior leaders, challenge a mis-scoped search and make a hiring process better without creating unnecessary friction.

• Comfort using data to understand funnel health, diagnose problems and hold an honest conversation about what needs to change.

• High ownership. You book the next step while you have the candidate, chase what is stuck and do not wait for a detailed brief to get useful work moving.

• Specific, sharp written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should never feel template-driven.

Nice to Have

• Experience recruiting for a fintech, SaaS, infrastructure or similarly complex B2B product.

• Experience joining a company as the first recruiter in a new geography, or helping to scale an international business.

• Experience building an AI-augmented recruiting research workflow.

Why this Role

You will have unusual ownership over one of Ramp's most important growth priorities, with the support of an established Talent team rather than the isolation of a one-person recruiting function. Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

  • Act as a local territory expert: Build deep insight into the regional Asian culinary scene, travelling across London and adjacent areas like Oxford, Cambridge, and Norwich to identify key brands that local customers crave.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Language proficiency: Fluency in Chinese Mandarin with the ability to negotiate and build professional commercial partnerships.

  • Proven new business acquisition: Demonstrated sales experience with a track record of actively targeting new business and consistently delivering against demanding commercial targets.

  • Commercial negotiation skills: Strong commercial acumen with the ability to handle negotiations, understand marketplace economics, and structure profitable, sustainable deals.

  • Autonomy and field-based resilience: A self-motivated, tenacious approach with the ability to work independently and spend significant time out on the road meeting prospects.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

 

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

 

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

 

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?”

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential.

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale: work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast: ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership: take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

  • 🌎 A culture built for builders: high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.

  • 💰 Share in the success you help create: competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.

  • Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

  • Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

  • Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

What You'll Bring

  • Solid UK GDPR and data protection experience

  • Genuine curiosity about how controls actually work — you're not satisfied when "the box is ticked," you want to understand the journey behind it

  • Hyper-organised — you can run multiple concurrent workstreams (audits, questionnaires, training, policy updates) without anything slipping

  • A builder's mindset — comfortable creating and automating a process from nothing, not just following an existing playbook

  • Autonomous and idea-driven — you'll be directed on priorities, not micromanaged on approach

  • Mid-level compliance/GRC/information security experience — your background does not need to be from AI infrastructure, data centres, or a related industry

  • Confident stakeholder management — you'll work directly with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, not just within a compliance team

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycles

  • Exposure to business continuity or major incident processes

  • Familiarity with AI governance or emerging AI regulation

  • Interest in health & safety, environmental/ESG reporting, or physical security and facilities governance

  • Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or equivalent)

Why Join Radiant?

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Real ownership of a function you're building from the ground up, with senior support rather than senior oversight

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry, at the intersection of power, compute and capital

  • Backed by Brookfield — genuine resources, mentorship, and room to grow the role as the company scales

About 1st Formations

At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run and grow their businesses with confidence.

We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, integrated platform bringing together company formation, compliance, accounting, payroll and ongoing business support.

We have strong momentum and ambitious plans for growth:

  • £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

  • Over 1 million companies formed

  • Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business

  • Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Credit Control Manager to take sole ownership of collections for our growing Accounting Service.

This is a hands-on, standalone role with considerable autonomy. You will be responsible for designing and building our credit control and collections process from the ground up, and then running it day-to-day.

Our Accounting Service is sold alongside a company formation package, discounted from £139.99 to £1. Customers who select the package commit to 11 monthly payments for the Accounting Service, with those payments remaining due under the customer agreement, whether or not the customer completes the accounting onboarding process.

Your job is straightforward: ensure contractual monthly payments are collected, missed payments are followed up on promptly, and arrears are resolved consistently and professionally.

This is not a traditional credit-risk role. You won’t be setting credit limits or negotiating commercial payment terms. The focus is on recurring contractual collections and creating a scalable collections operation as the Accounting Service grows.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, document, and own the end-to-end credit control and collections process.

  • Decide the collections timetable and contact strategy for missed and failed payments, including frequency of contact and escalation points.

  • Create and continually improve customer communications, including email templates, reminders and telephone scripts.

  • Personally manage day-to-day collections across a high volume of customer accounts by telephone and email.

  • Handle objections and difficult conversations confidently, including explaining customers’ contractual payment commitments where required.

  • Identify genuine billing or service issues and work with our Accounting, Onboarding, Customer Service and Finance teams to resolve them quickly.

  • Establish clear escalation routes for unresolved arrears and recommend when accounts should move to the next stage of recovery.

  • Maintain accurate records and provide management with clear reporting on arrears, collections, recovery rates, failed payments and reasons for non-payment.

  • Identify opportunities to improve payment recovery through better communications, processes, automation and payment-retry workflows.

What We’re Looking For

You will need strong hands-on experience in credit control, collections, or recurring payment recovery, ideally within a subscription, professional services, or other high-volume customer environment.

Just as importantly, we’re looking for someone who can build a collections function rather than simply inherit one.

You should be:

  • Experienced in creating, redesigning or materially improving collections processes.

  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of both the strategy and day-to-day collections activity.

  • Confident and effective on the telephone, including dealing with objections, complaints and difficult payment conversations.

  • An excellent written communicator who can create clear, professional and effective customer communications.

  • Firm, persistent and commercially minded while maintaining a professional approach to customers.

  • Highly organised and able to manage a large number of accounts, follow-ups and escalation actions.

  • Comfortable using finance, CRM or payment systems and Excel/Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.

  • Experience in accounting, bookkeeping or financial services would be useful but is not essential. Strong collections experience and the ability to build an effective process are more important.

  • A CICM qualification, or progress towards one, would be welcome but is not essential.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package

  • Hybrid working

  • A high-autonomy role with the opportunity to build and own a new collections function

  • Genuine opportunities for progression as the Accounting Service and wider business grow

  • The opportunity to influence customer experience, billing processes and product development

  • A culture that values ownership, impact and continuous learning

Equal Opportunities

1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals from all backgrounds and will make reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities or additional needs.

About Odin

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Responsibilities

We’re hiring a Founding Growth Lead to design and scale Odin’s Growth engine.

 

Odin already has strong organic inbound and brand pull. Most of our new business is driven by word of mouth, plus Google or AI search. However, there is no systematic engine driving it. We're hiring a Founding Growth Marketer to change that.

 

The primary responsibility is to create a repeatable, scalable system that brings the right people into our inbound pipeline.

 

This means building the growth loops that turn prospects and existing customers into new revenue, using modern GTM tooling, marketing automation and whatever else it takes to generate high-quality MQLs for the sales team.

 

It also means experimenting with product-led growth and growth hacking: ideating, testing and improving loops that compound over time, and working with external agency partners and the wider team on viral campaigns, AI, SEO, or whatever else helps us capture and convert ICP prospects into MQLs.

 

Who We’re Looking For

This is a role for a high-agency operator with strong commercial instinct, product-mindedness and systems thinking.

 

You take ownership and thrive in uncertainty.

 

Comfort running complex sales and marketing systems is essential. The ability to understand problems and improve them quickly & deliberately is equally important. You're intensely curious, methodical and scientific in your approach to growth.

 

Background matters less than capability. The right profile may be:

  • Senior Growth Marketer: A strong performer who thinks outside the box

  • Revenue or Growth Operator: Experience building PLG motions, activation loops or pipeline systems in high-velocity environments.

Across profiles, strong candidates should demonstrate:

This is a founding role. Scope will evolve as we grow. There won’t be tightly defined lanes or heavy oversight. You set direction, solves what matters and is accountable for outcomes. Your told what the business needs, you figure out how to do it.

Salary

Compensation includes a £100,000–£120,000 base, £150,000–£180,000+ OTE and a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of equity & cash compensation.

Working at Odin

About forgd

forgd is the consultancy partnering exclusively with Anthropic to help enterprises build AI-native businesses. We start with engineering — helping organizations move from individual developers using Claude Code to entire teams shipping together with AI-native workflows — and expand into agentic solution delivery and broader business transformation.

Our conviction is that engineers are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. The strongest mental model for designing, deploying, and governing AI agents in production lives in software engineering. The teams that change how their organization builds software are the same teams equipped to shepherd the rest of the business into this new world.

We embed and co-build with customer teams. Cycles are short, delivery is iterative and accountable to clear outcome goals.

 

About the Role

As an FDE, you embed with enterprise customers and own the technical work across the full customer journey — initial demos, short proof-of-value engagements, and multi-week implementations. The work moves customers from interesting prototypes to production capability.

Most engagements start in engineering. You'll work with customer engineering teams adopting Claude Code and redesigning their SDLC — code review, requirements, testing, documentation, and governance. From there, the work expands: co-building agentic applications and modernizing legacy systems on the Claude developer platform, and partnering with business stakeholders to deploy agents into core operations like sales, customer service, and finance.

You're the expert in the room on how engineers work with Claude Code, what an agentic application looks like in production, and what has to change in an organization to sustain either. You build prototypes, ship code, run workshops, write specs, and make the calls that move customers from demos to deployment.

Collaborate directly with Anthropic on customer engagements — joint working sessions, early access to product changes, and a direct line to their product and engineering teams.

About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning a portfolio of fleet customers end to end, from onboarding through to renewal, with clear accountability for keeping them

  • Handling inbound policy queries from customers and brokers by phone and email, resolving them quickly and helping people self-serve where that suits them better

  • Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

  • Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

  • Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

  • Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

  • Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

What you'll need

  • A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

  • Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

  • Hunger to learn and real coachability. We will teach you the insurance and the telematics

  • Clear written and spoken communication, with a knack for making complex things easy to understand, and the confidence to present to clients

  • A proactive attitude to getting the job done, even when the answer takes some digging

  • Organisation across a busy and varied workload, with the accuracy and attention to detail to match the pace

  • Evidence you already use AI tools to work better, or a genuine appetite to build that habit fast

  • Desirable, not required: time working with fleets, or exposure to motor insurance

 

Benefits

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. About the role

We are hiring a Head of Migrations to lead all migration work across the business. You will be the single accountable owner of our migration pipeline, created in direct response to the volume of AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) engagements now running across our client base.

The remit goes wider than MAP workload migrations. You will lead data centre exit programmes and landing zone migrations too, building a repeatable set of methodologies and delivery assets for each rather than running every engagement bespoke.

Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here.

data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

This is one of the most important leadership hires in the EMEA business. The Head of KAM — EMEA will own Statista’s most strategically important accounts and lead the team that protects and grows the commercial relationships that underpin our 2026 stability and 2027 acceleration.

You will report directly to the VP Sales EMEA and sit on the EMEA commercial leadership team. This is not a steady-state account management role. It is a transformation mandate — to rebuild the KAM function into an enterprise-grade strategic account motion that moves our most important clients from users of data to institutional partners embedded in Statista’s AI and intelligence infrastructure.

What success looks like - First 12 months

• GRR stabilised across the KAM book through structured renewal discipline, early intervention on at-risk accounts, and a clear early-warning system.

• Every KAM account has a live account plan — org map, stakeholder map, expansion roadmap, and renewal forecast.

• Economic buyer engagement across the top tier — conversations at VP, Director, and C-suite level, not just with research and insights teams.

• Connect adoption initiated in strategically important accounts — from licence conversation to embedded data infrastructure.

• KAM team assessed, coached, and operating to an enterprise standard — structured QBRs, value realisation conversations, and expansion plays running consistently.

• Investment case for FY27 KAM expansion — headcount, coverage model, and tooling — presented to the CCO.

Your tasks

Lead and Transform the KAM Team

• Own the day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance management of the EMEA KAM team.

• Assess each KAM against the enterprise motion requirements and build individual development plans. Not everyone will be on the same journey — that is a leadership decision, not a management failure.

• Build a coaching standard grounded in enterprise selling: consultative discovery, multi-stakeholder navigation, C-suite engagement, and business case construction.

• Develop the team’s ability to move from user-level relationships to economic buyer access — and to carry a complex, multi-product conversation with credibility.

• Install a peer coaching culture where KAMs learn from each other under a clear standard, not only from you.

Protect GRR in 2026

• Own the renewal and churn-prevention motion across the KAM book.

• Build an early-warning system for at-risk accounts — usage signals, stakeholder changes, competitor activity, budget cycles — with clear escalation and intervention protocols.

• Partner with Customer Success leadership to ensure joined-up coverage across adoption, value realisation, and renewal.

• Conduct and coach structured QBRs that demonstrate ROI and surface expansion signals — not renewal conversations dressed up as business reviews.

Drive the Enterprise Account Motion

• Build and embed the account planning standard across the KAM team — org mapping, stakeholder matrix, commercial roadmap, and expansion sequencing.

• Lead the movement from user-level selling to economic buyer engagement across the top-tier KAM book.

• Own the Connect and Statista+ expansion motion — identifying accounts where data infrastructure conversations are ready to open, and coaching KAMs to run them.

• Build the institutional knowledge that makes Statista’s largest accounts structurally difficult to displace.

Drive NRR Growth

• Own NRR targets across the KAM portfolio. Define the expansion plays that unlock commercial headroom in existing accounts.

• Identify accounts where Connect’s consumption-based model opens a new commercial conversation with a new buyer — technical, commercial, and C-suite.

• Create structured handoffs with the Customer Success and Scale teams to ensure expansion signals are acted on, not lost.

• Champion the full OneStatista platform — core, Connect, Statista+, and IQ roadmap — in every strategic account engagement.

Shape the Commercial Operating Model

• Define the KAM coverage model — which accounts receive full KAM attention, at what intensity, and how that changes as the portfolio evolves.

• Partner with the VP Sales EMEA on the FY27 KAM investment case — headcount, tooling, and the team structure required to operate an enterprise motion at scale.

• Represent EMEA KAM in global commercial leadership forums — bringing regional evidence and recommendations to shape global strategy and playbooks.

• Work closely with New Business leadership to ensure the accounts being landed are the right accounts — and that the handoff from new business to KAM is clean.

Your profile

Essential

• Substantial enterprise account management or key account leadership experience — managing strategic relationships at VP, Director, and C-suite level, with deals at £100k+ ACV.

• Evidence of building or materially improving a KAM or enterprise account function — account planning, coverage models, QBR standards, and expansion playbooks.

• Proven track record of protecting GRR and growing NRR in a subscription-based model.

• Commercial instinct for the enterprise motion — value discovery, business case construction, multi-stakeholder navigation, and land-and-expand execution.

• Experience developing and coaching account managers to raise the quality of their commercial conversations — not just their activity levels.

• Ability to lead change in a team that is transitioning from a transactional to an enterprise model — without losing the team in the process.

Desirable

• Experience in data, intelligence, research, information services, or AI-adjacent platforms.

• Familiarity with consumption-based or usage-based commercial models.

• Exposure to enterprise procurement, legal, and compliance conversations in regulated industries.

• Experience working across multiple European markets in a matrixed organisation.

Why join Statista?

• The most strategically important leadership role in the EMEA commercial organisation. What you build here defines Statista’s growth trajectory.

• Direct line to the VP Sales EMEA and CCO — your commercial judgement will shape decisions at the top of the business.

• A product story that is only getting stronger — Connect, Statista+, and StatistaIQ give you a genuinely differentiated platform to build enterprise relationships around.

• The mandate to rebuild for enterprise — with CEO and board alignment behind the direction. The strategy is set. The opportunity is to execute it.

• Real runway. Build this well in 2026 and you will own the enterprise account engine for one of the most recognised data platforms in the world.

Working Model and Compensation

• Hybrid working from our London office, with regular travel across EMEA and to Hamburg HQ.

• Competitive base salary commensurate with senior enterprise leadership — range shared at initial screen. Above-band compensation considered for exceptional candidates.

• Performance-linked OTE. Pension, private healthcare, and core benefits.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will move through a structured process:

• Initial screen with Talent Acquisition.

• In-depth conversation with the VP Sales EMEA.

• Panel interview with CCO and a commercial peer.

• Strategic account plan presentation and live exercise.

Inclusive Application

Statista is committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We recognise that strong candidates may not meet every listed criterion. If the role interests you and your experience is relevant, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

About the Role

The CEO - AI Stockbroking will build and own an AI-native stockbroking business. The role combines brokerage infrastructure and market expertise with AI-native research, discovery and trading experiences.

What you will be doing

  • Define the AI Stockbroking proposition, product roadmap and business model.

  • Build AI-native experiences across stock discovery, research, trading, portfolio management and market information.

  • Own P&L, funded accounts, assets, trading activity, revenue and unit economics.

  • Build the brokerage product and underlying trading, custody and market infrastructure.

  • Work deeply with product, engineering and AI teams on product capabilities and execution.

  • Own brokerage, custody, market data and other key partnerships.

  • Build the core team and drive licensing, regulatory readiness and market expansion.

What you will need

  • Deep experience in stockbroking, brokerage, trading or consumer investing.

  • Direct ownership of a meaningful brokerage or trading product, business or P&L.

  • Strong understanding of brokerage economics, trading infrastructure, markets and regulation.

  • Strong product judgement and understanding of how AI can improve stock discovery, research and trading workflows.

  • Experience building and scaling technology products and teams.

  • Hands-on operating capability. Able to work directly through product flows, brokerage infrastructure, economics and execution.

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and system engineering software for manufacturing. We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. data.description:
In this role, you will support our Supply Planning team in translating demand forecasts into feasible production and replenishment plans. You will help ensure that materials are available, production schedules remain on track, and key stakeholders stay aligned.

This position offers a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in supply and production planning within a fast-growing FMCG environment, while working closely with experienced planners and cross-functional teams.

What you'll do

  • Support the creation and maintenance of production and supply schedules in alignment with demand forecasts

  • Assist in coordinating with Demand Planning and Purchasing to help ensure timely availability of raw materials and components

  • Help track production performance versus plan and support the team in identifying variances or risks

  • Prepare reports, analyses, and planning data in Excel or ERP systems to support decision-making

  • Contribute to cross-functional coordination by supporting communication with operations, purchasing, and marketing teams

  • Assist with ad-hoc analyses, data checks, and process improvements within the planning team

     

Your profile

 

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on operations, production, or planning

  • Availability: Ideally available for around 20 hours per week and able to commit for at least 8 months, so you can grow into the role and gain meaningful hands-on experience

  • Strong analytical mindset and genuine interest in how supply chains, production flows, and forecasting processes work in practice

  • Confident working with data and Excel; experience with ERP or planning tools is a strong plus

  • Structured, detail-oriented, and reliable working style with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines

  • Proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus

Nice to have / strong advantage:

  • First practical experience (internship working student role) in Supply Planning or Production Planning

  • Exposure to FMCG, food, supplements, cosmetics, or other high-volume production environments

What we offer

  • An attractive discount on our full product range – from essential oils to vitamins and minerals

  • Ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, with the opportunity to contribute your expertise and turn your own ideas into action

  • Hands-on experience in a dynamic Operations environment and insight into the operational and strategic sides of Suppy Planning

  • Opportunities to contribute to real projects and make an impact

  • Inviting office spaces with a wide selection of organic teas and superfoods from around the world to taste and enjoy

  • We love to celebrate together! Regular tea and office parties, Christmas and summer events, and numerous influencer events, such as Women’s Day

 
 

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

data.description:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As Founder's Associate at NetBird, you'll work directly with our founders and Chief of Staff as a sparring partner and execution engine on the topics that matter most to the company. This is a high-trust, high-ownership role for someone who wants to see, and shape, how a fast-growing open source startup is built, from strategy to day-to-day execution.

Specifically, you will:

  • Own strategic projects across growth, product, operations, and fundraising end to end, from first analysis to shipped result

  • Help grow the team, from running recruiting operations to winning exceptional people for NetBird

  • Research markets, competitors, and customer needs to identify new opportunities and risks before they become obvious

  • Drive cross-team initiatives and keep Product, Growth, and Engineering aligned on critical company milestones

  • Design and improve the internal processes that keep a scaling company running, and take ownership of whatever matters most right now, from testing new GTM ideas to unblocking the founders

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for an exceptional generalist: highly motivated, analytical, and hands-on, with the ambition to help build and scale a tech startup from the inside.

What you bring

  • A track record of excellence and real ownership, for example through top academic results from a top tier university or internships in high-caliber startups, venture capital, investment banking, or strategy consulting

  • You're highly structured, organized, and able to drive multiple topics in parallel without losing your eye for detail

  • You enjoy working with data, building models, and turning insights into action, but also have a hands-on mentality

  • You're comfortable taking a vague problem, defining it, and driving it to a result

🌟 What makes you a great fit

These are the values we work by as a team, and what they mean for this role:

  • Own the outcome: Small team, real scope. You take problems end to end and ship something that works today instead of polishing a plan for weeks.

  • Default to candor: Direct, kind, and specific, whether you're challenging a colleague's assumption or receiving feedback yourself. The best argument wins.

  • Stay close to the user: You don't have to be an engineer, but you're genuinely curious about our product and the open source community behind it.

😌 What's in for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity: everyone at NetBird owns a piece of what we're building

  • Close collaboration with our co-founders: work with them day to day and learn how a startup is really built

  • High impact: your projects directly shape NetBird's trajectory

  • Hybrid setup: a centrally located Berlin office with flexibility for remote days

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass), and dinner on us when you're working late

data.description:
Q ENERGYs Ziel ist es, eine nachhaltige Welt mit grüner Energie zu ermöglichen. Unsere Unternehmenswerte - Verantwortung, Partnerschaft, Inklusive and "Changemaker" - sind die Grundlage für unser Handeln. Als Europas führender Anbieter von grünen Energielösungen sind wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für das gesamte Spektrum der erneuerbaren Energien. Unser Ziel ist es, die Welt mit Solar-, Wind- und Hybridkraftwerken, innovativen Speicherlösungen und visionären grünen Wasserstoffprojekten neu zu definieren. 

Begleite uns auf dieser spannenden Reise, um unseren Planeten nachhaltig zu verändern.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte Projektmanager (m/w/d), die die erfolgreiche Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekten von der ersten Standortidee bis zur Genehmigungsreife und Übergabe in die Realisierung verantwortet.

 

Ziel der Rolle ist es, wirtschaftlich attraktive, genehmigungsfähige und technisch umsetzbare Projekte zu identifizieren und gezielt voranzutreiben. Dabei übernimmst Du die ganzheitliche Steuerung der Projekte sowie die Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder und stellst die Einhaltung von Zeit-, Kosten-, Qualitäts- und Entwicklungszielen sicher.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Projektakquise und Standortentwicklung: Identifikation, Bewertung und Sicherung geeigneter Standorte und Flächen für Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekte einschließlich Machbarkeitsanalysen und Flächensicherung.
  • Projektentwicklung und Genehmigung: Entwicklung und Optimierung von Projekten, Steuerung der Genehmigungs- und Planungsverfahren sowie Koordination von Gutachtern, Planern, Behörden und weiteren Projektpartnern.
  • Technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung: Bewertung von Netzanschlussmöglichkeiten, Projektlayouts und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Risiken und Projektbudgets.
  • Stakeholder- und Projektmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Grundstückseigentümern, Kommunen, Behörden, Netzbetreibern und Geschäftspartnern sowie Koordination der internen und externen Projektbeteiligten.
  • Projektabschluss und Übergabe: Vorbereitung der Projekte für Finanzierung, Vermarktung, Verkauf oder Übergabe in die Bau- und Realisierungsphase.

Requirements

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im technischen oder energiewirtschaftlichen Umfeld.
  • Berufserfahrung in der Projektentwicklung im Bereich erneuerbare Energien, der Netzintegration oder der Netzanschlussplanung.
  • Gute Kenntnisse regulatorischer- und Grundkenntnisse netztechnischer Anforderungen.
  • Analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und starkes Schnittstellenmanagement.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf professionellem Niveau sowie fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt.

Benefits

  • Flexibler Arbeitsort: Du hast die Möglichkeit, remote von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Zusätzlich steht dir unser modernes und nachhaltiges Büro in Berlin-Südkreuz zur Verfügung, das eine gute Anbindung und eine angenehme Arbeitsumgebung bietet.
  • IT-Ausstattung: Wir stellen dir einen Laptop, Monitor, Kopfhörer und, falls erforderlich, ein Diensthandy zur Verfügung.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Deine Zeit ist wertvoll! Gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel, damit du persönliche Termine wahrnehmen, früher ins Wochenende starten oder einfach das Leben besser mit der Arbeit in Einklang bringen kannst. Du entscheidest.
  • Spendit Card: Monatlich 50 € zusätzlich zum Gehalt, die du für dein tägliches Mittagessen nutzen oder unbegrenzt ansparen kannst.
  • Großzügige Urlaubsregelung: Genieße 31 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, um dich zu erholen, neue Energie zu tanken und die Welt zu entdecken.
  • Onboarding: Mit einem strukturierten Onboarding-Prozess sorgen wir für einen reibungslosen Start und begleiten dich von Tag eins an, damit du dich gut aufgehoben fühlst.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir leisten einen monatlichen Beitrag von 13,29 € zu deiner Altersvorsorge.
  • Versicherungsschutz: Unfall- und Lebensversicherung sind inklusive – für deine Sicherheit und ein gutes Gefühl, sowohl im Job als auch privat.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Über unser Corporate Benefits-Programm erhältst du exklusive Rabatte auf zahlreiche Marken und Produkte.
  • Firmenwagen: Falls du berechtigt bist und dein Job es erfordert, steht dir ein Firmenwagen zur Verfügung.
  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement: Deine Gesundheit steht an erster Stelle! Profitiere von unserem Gesundheitsmanagement, inklusive Vorsorgeuntersuchungen, um fit und leistungsfähig zu bleiben.

Möchtest du Teil von Q ENERGY werden?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Bitte teile uns dabei deine Gehaltsvorstellung sowie dein frühestmögliches Startdatum mit.

Hinweis: Wir akzeptieren keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze für deine Bewerbung den „Jetzt bewerben“-Button. Vielen Dank!

Bei Fragen steht dir unser Recruiting-Team gerne zur ----- ENERGY ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen – bei uns arbeiten Menschen aus verschiedenen Nationen, Kulturen und Standorten partnerschaftlich zusammen und tauschen ihre Erfahrungen und Werte in einer offenen und kollegialen Atmosphäre aus.
