data.title: Projektentwickler - Ostdeutschland (m/w/d)

data.description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. 

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben.

Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz.


Was dich erwartet

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases.
  • Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap.
  • Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase.
  • Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact.
  • Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales.
  • Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen.
  • Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle.


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus.
  • Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.
  • Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken.
  • Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch.


Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt.
  • Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche.
  • Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert:  Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.

Build Recruiting. Build Navius.

Navius startet in eine neue Phase.

Wir wollen nicht die nächste Recruiting-Agentur aufbauen, die möglichst viele Profile verschickt, Prozesse verwaltet und Aktivität mit Erfolg verwechselt.

Wir wollen Recruiting so machen, wie wir es selbst für richtig halten:

persönlich, verbindlich, datenbasiert und mit einem hohen Anspruch an die Qualität unserer Arbeit.

Dafür suchen wir einen erfahrenen Recruiter oder eine erfahrene Recruiterin, der oder die nicht einfach eine bestehende Rolle übernimmt, sondern Recruiting bei Navius mit aufbaut.

Als Founding Recruiter übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung für eigene Mandate und Kunden. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns Prozesse, Technologie und die Art, wie wir künftig Recruiting machen.

Ergebnis vor Aktivität ist dabei eines unserer zentralen Prinzipien. Arbeit beginnt bei uns mit einem klaren Ziel und endet mit einem messbaren Ergebnis.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest deine Recruiting-Mandate eigenständig von der Auftragsklärung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.

Dabei wirst du

  • unsere Kunden direkt beraten und Anforderungen gemeinsam mit ihnen challengen

  • individuelle Such- und Sourcingstrategien entwickeln

  • Kandidaten und Kandidatinnen identifizieren und direkt ansprechen

  • Screenings und Interviews führen

  • Kandidaten fundiert bewerten und unseren Kunden vorstellen

  • mehrere Recruiting-Projekte parallel steuern

  • eng mit Hiring Managern und Entscheidern zusammenarbeiten

  • langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln

  • unsere Recruiting-Prozesse von Anfang an mitgestalten

  • KI, Automatisierung und moderne Recruiting-Technologie dort einsetzen, wo sie unsere Arbeit tatsächlich besser machen

Eine erfolgreiche Besetzung ist für uns nicht das Ende. Gute Arbeit zeigt sich auch daran, dass Kunden bei ihrem nächsten Hiring-Bedarf wieder mit Navius arbeiten wollen.

Und weil du zu den ersten Menschen gehörst, die Navius mit aufbauen, geht deine Rolle über Delivery hinaus. Du kannst mitentscheiden, wie Recruiting bei Navius künftig funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Eine perfekte Checkliste gibt es bei uns nicht. Recruiting-Erfahrung brauchst du trotzdem.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du

  • bereits mehrere Jahre eigenständig im Recruiting gearbeitet hast
  • Active Sourcing, Interviews und die Steuerung kompletter Recruiting-Prozesse kennst
  • Kunden beraten kannst und auch widersprichst, wenn du fachlich anderer Meinung bist
  • Verantwortung übernimmst und Entscheidungen selbstständig treffen kannst
  • strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeitest
  • einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch hast, ohne dich in Perfektion zu verlieren
  • neugierig auf Technologie und KI bist und neue Wege ausprobierst
  • Lust auf Aufbau statt ausschließlich auf fertige Strukturen hast
  • du kommunizierst sicher und professionell auf Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl im Gespräch als auch schriftlich

Uns interessiert dabei nicht nur, was du bisher gemacht hast, sondern wie du denkst und arbeitest.

Klarheit ist uns wichtiger als kurzfristige Harmonie. Verantwortung ist uns wichtiger als Ausreden. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven und konstruktiver Widerspruch gehören ausdrücklich zu unserer Zusammenarbeit.

Benefits

Work where it works for you

Wir kontrollieren keine Anwesenheit. Arbeite dort, wo du produktiv bist – remote, im Coworking Space oder gemeinsam mit uns vor Ort. Coworking-Möglichkeiten stehen dir deutschlandweit zur Verfügung.

Vertrauen statt Micromanagement

Wir definieren Ziele und Ergebnisse. Deinen Kalender wollen wir nicht kontrollieren.

Echter Gestaltungsspielraum

Du kommst nicht in eine fertige Recruiting-Organisation. Du baust sie mit auf und kannst Prozesse, Tools und Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitgestalten.

Moderne Ausstattung

Gute Hardware, professionelle Recruiting-Systeme, LinkedIn und die Tools, die du brauchst, um deinen Job richtig gut zu machen.

KI gehört zum Job

Nicht als Buzzword. Wir wollen Technologie konsequent dort einsetzen, wo sie uns schneller oder besser macht und mehr Zeit für die Arbeit schafft, bei der Menschen den Unterschied machen.

Direkter Kundenzugang

Kein Account Manager zwischen dir und dem Kunden. Du arbeitest direkt mit Hiring Managern und Entscheidern.

Perspektive

Mit Navius soll auch unser Recruiting-Team wachsen. Als Founding Recruiter kannst du perspektivisch Verantwortung für dieses Team übernehmen.

Gehalt

45.000–50.000 Euro brutto pro Jahr plus variable Vergütung.

Unser variables Modell belohnt nicht die schnellste Besetzung, sondern gute Arbeit, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und daraus entstehendes Folgegeschäft.

Wir respektieren Fokus. Meetings brauchen einen Zweck, Fokuszeiten werden respektiert und Nein-Sagen ist ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Wir suchen keinen Recruiter und keine Recruiterin, um einfach einen freien Platz in einem bestehenden Organigramm zu besetzen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Lust darauf hat, früh dabei zu sein und Recruiting bei Navius mit aufzubauen.

Unsere fünf Prinzipien geben dabei ziemlich gut wieder, was du von uns erwarten kannst – und was wir auch von dir erwarten:

Ergebnis vor Aktivität.
Klarheit vor Harmonie.
Verantwortung vor Ausreden.
Respekt vor Zeit und Fokus.
Vielfalt als Leistungsfaktor.

Wenn du damit nichts anfangen kannst, werden wir wahrscheinlich nicht zusammenpassen.

Wenn du beim Lesen dagegen mehrfach gedacht hast „Genau so möchte ich arbeiten“, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Vergiss das perfekte Anschreiben.

Schick uns deinen CV oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum du Lust hast, als Founding Recruiter Recruiting bei Navius mit aufzubauen.

About the team:

You'll join one of the teams within SumUp's Identity Lifecycle Mission, working on some of the most critical building blocks behind the merchant journey, from onboarding and identity verification to KYC/KYB, regulatory data collection, and managing customer identity throughout the entire lifecycle.

Today, many of these capabilities live across different flows, legacy services, and tightly coupled integrations. We're on a journey to bring these pieces together into a more coherent, scalable platform, with shared data models, reusable services, and clear ownership boundaries.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you won't just be maintaining existing systems. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our identity platform evolves, modernise critical services, and help build foundations that can support new regulations, markets, and product requirements without reinventing the wheel every time.

You'll be part of one dedicated team, but the challenges we tackle often cross team and domain boundaries. You'll work closely with Engineers, Product, Design, Compliance, Risk, and Operations, giving you the opportunity to influence solutions well beyond your own team.

If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, working in a highly collaborative environment, improving reliability, and building scalable capabilities that enable other teams to move faster, this could be an exciting opportunity to make a real impact at SumUp.

 

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and operate scalable backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and system integrations.
  • Build reusable capabilities that power merchant onboarding, identity verification, and KYC/KYB regulatory data collection.
  • Drive reliability and resilience across critical services through better observability, failure handling, incident response, and long-term risk reduction.
  • Work primarily with Go, while maintaining and progressively modernising existing services written in Java.
  • Evolve domain models and service boundaries while reducing legacy complexity, duplicated logic, and tightly coupled integrations, always with a pragmatic, incremental mindset.
  • Own your work end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to rollout and production follow-up.
  • Work across team and domain boundaries, turning ambiguous product and regulatory requirements into clear, scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code and designs, mentor engineers, and help raise engineering standards across the mission.

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

  • Strong professional experience building and operating production backend systems with high business impact. 
  • Experience working with Go and Java and confidence in maintaining and evolving existing Java services.
  • Strong knowledge of API design, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, data modelling, testing, and system design.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka and modern observability tools such as Grafana or Honeycomb.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior News Editor to join our team. At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in helping us turn the mydealz Magazine into Germany's most trusted source for money-saving journalism, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

Reader Value and Deal Judgement:

  • Identify why an offer matters to someone trying to save money, and name the concrete saving lever behind the price, use community signals as reporting evidence.

Content Creation and Management:

  • Write strong and engaging headlines and copy, and develop story ideas and coverage plans.
  • Own the weekly editorial plan for the German edition and make sure stories land on time and at standard.
  • Own recurring shopping events end to end: planning, hub pages, live coverage, post-mortem.
  • Choose images, videos, and other media with a keen eye to increase the quality of our content.

Proofreading and Editing:

  • Own keyword research, title and heading structure, internal linking and structured data.
  • Edit articles for grammatical accuracy, factual consistency, and style consistency according to our guidelines.
  • Brief, review and sign off articles from staff editors and freelance contributors, with written feedback.
  • Optimize content for search engines (SEO/GEO) and digital platforms to maximize reach and engagement.

Performance Analysis:

  • Track conversion rates, organic (Google) traffic, and click-through rates.
  • Turn those numbers into a weekly decision: what to repeat, what to fix, what to stop.

Collaboration and Coordination:

  • Work with the platform's Editorial department, PR, Commercial and Social to gather insights and coordinate coverage.

Expertise and Author Credibility:

  • Track the market you cover, from launches and price cycles to retailer moves, and turn it into a topic pipeline rather than a reading list.
  • Keep a network you can actually call: manufacturers, independent testers, and the mydealz Community. Representing us publicly is welcome, not required.

AI knowledge and Expansion:

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI), its current applications, and potential future developments, particularly in the context of journalism and content creation.
  • Use AI tooling in daily production within our editorial guidelines, and build and maintain the desk's prompts and skills.

Crisis Management:

  •  Stay calm and efficient under pressure.

Compliance Monitoring:

  • Ensure all stories comply with legal guidelines and journalistic standards.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with at least 3 years of editorial experience in an online newsroom, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • Editorial: Published work you can point to, ability to find the story in a price, clean handling of numbers and sources.
  • Technical Skills: CMS routine (ideally WordPress with Gutenberg), Google Search Console, an SEO suite (Ahrefs or Semrush), price-history tools (Idealo, Keepa, CamelCamelCamel), hands-on AI tooling in a production workflow.
  • Soft Skills: Judgement under time pressure, giving and taking feedback, clear communication across departments, ownership without being asked.
  • Language requirements: Fluent German and English.

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

data.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the role

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.

This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.

What you'll be doing

  • You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
  • You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
  • You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
  • You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.

Our humble expectations

  • The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
  • Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
  • There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
  • The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues. 

This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.

Next steps

You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role. The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

data.description:
As Product Manager – Product Launches, you will own the end-to-end execution of new and upgraded product launches across PERGOLUX markets worldwide. You will be responsible for turning product development into successful market launches by ensuring every critical requirement—from supplier readiness and product documentation to inventory, ecommerce setup, training, compliance, and quality gates—is completed before go-live. At PERGOLUX, we are building a premium outdoor-living brand with ambitious global growth, bringing together international teams through a culture of integrity, ambition, innovation, humility, appreciation, and unity.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end execution of assigned new product and product-upgrade launches across Europe, the US, Australia, and other PERGOLUX markets, managing launch plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, responsibilities, and go/no-go decisions.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Product Development, manufacturing suppliers, Supply Chain, Ecommerce, Content, Marketing, Sales, Customer Service, Compliance, and Country Managers to ensure complete launch readiness across markets and time zones.

  • Drive operational readiness by ensuring specifications, installation manuals, certifications, compliance documentation, pricing, SKUs, product content, translations, imagery, Shopify setup, inventory, team training, and support materials are accurate, complete, and approved before launch.

  • Define and operate clear quality gates and launch-readiness processes, coordinating manufacturer, field, and laboratory testing, identifying risks early, driving solutions, escalating critical issues, and providing clear launch-status reporting to Product leadership and key stakeholders.

  • Continuously improve how we launch products by owning installation manual quality, managing SKU phase-outs and product transitions, conducting post-launch retrospectives, maintaining risk logs and rollout trackers, and reducing avoidable rework and post-launch issues.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Technical Project Management, or a similar execution-focused role, with experience coordinating product launches, new product introductions, or complex cross-functional projects.

  • Strong project planning, timeline management, stakeholder coordination, and structured reporting skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple workstreams and maintain momentum toward critical deadlines.

  • Confidence working with physical products, technical specifications, installation manuals, specification sheets, and other product documentation, with strong attention to detail and ownership of quality.

  • Experience coordinating directly with overseas or offshore manufacturing suppliers and working effectively across departments, cultures, and time zones; experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Excel, Shopify, Zendesk, or Airtable is a plus.

  • A proactive, highly accountable mindset: you identify problems early, ask the right questions, follow actions through to completion, make sound day-to-day decisions independently, and know when commercial, compliance, or strategic decisions require escalation.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary & Bonus Structure – Your success is rewarded with strong compensation and performance-based bonuses.

  • Real Ownership – Take meaningful responsibility in your role and directly influence key business outcomes.

  • International Team – Collaborate with passionate colleagues across Europe, gaining exposure to diverse perspectives and ideas.

  • Outdoor Lifestyle Discounts – Enjoy exclusive discounts on PERGOLUX products.

  • Fast-Track Career Opportunities – As we scale quickly, you’ll have significant opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles.

  • Team Culture – Be part of regular team events, retreats, and a culture that celebrates wins—big and small.

  • Bike Leasing Program – Benefit from a sustainable and cost-effective bike leasing option to support commuting and an active lifestyle.

How to Apply

Interested in joining PERGOLUX? We’d love to hear from you. Learn more about our team and opportunities on our PERGOLUX LinkedIn and apply through our PERGOLUX Career Page.

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Do you want to be the voice that connects a global community of professional photographers?

Are you ready to master the balance between reliable social media execution and genuine community engagement using the latest AI tools?

...then you are our perfect match!

Prepare for a steep learning curve in a high-growth SaaS environment where you’ll see the direct impact of your work on our global photographer community from week one.

What You'll Do

  • Social Media Publishing: You create, schedule, and publish content planned by our campaign owners across Facebook and Instagram. You’ll adapt material for format, crop, and captioning to ensure it hits the mark every time.

  • Community Support: You are the heartbeat of our Facebook community—answering routine threads, welcoming new members, and ensuring no question sits unanswered.

  • Smart Routing: You’ll identify questions that need deep product knowledge and route them to the right internal experts, ensuring our photographers get the answers they need.

  • AI-Enabled Workflow: You’ll use our internal AI tools to draft replies and find help center resources faster, keeping our tone consistent while maintaining a human touch.

  • Team Support: You’ll pitch in on smaller marketing tasks and German-language content support, working closely with the Community & Education Manager.

What You'll Bring
Experience

  • You are currently enrolled at a university with at least one year of study remaining, ideally in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

  • Ideally, you have already held a working student position in a marketing or social media environment.

  • You have a proven track record of being reliable and self-organized.

Skills

  • Bilingual Excellence: You are fluent in German and have strong professional English skills.

  • Platform Native: Instagram and Facebook are second nature to you; you understand how to adapt content for different audiences.

  • Communication Speed: You write clearly, quickly, and can adapt your tone to match the GotPhoto brand.

Mindset

data.description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.

Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on-screen. The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture.

We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it.

What you'll own

  • The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.
  • The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team.
  • Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers.
  • Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits.

How we work

Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them.

Feedback runs both ways, and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.

We like this work, and you'll notice. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems.
  • Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily.
  • Analytics-data experience: real SQL depth, plus any of Parquet/Arrow/DuckDB/dbt/warehouse internals.
  • Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance).
  • Data pipelines over heterogeneous sources (ERP exports, Excel, CSV) onto object storage (S3 or comparable), built to keep working as customers and formats grow.
  • Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior.
  • Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away.
  • You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight.
  • You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool.
  • You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work.
  • German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.
  • NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.

Nice to have: a substantial migration you carried out end to end (system, stack, or data) · telemetry and observability · Cloudflare or comparable serverless infrastructure · frontend experience, ideally with Solid.js or another reactive framework · optimization/OR exposure · manufacturing or ERP data experience.

You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far.

This role is not for you if you want a clearly defined box, or work handed to you in tickets. We are a small team, pre-Series A: structures and processes are still being built, by us and by you. Priorities shift with customers, and some weeks a deadline bends the plan.

Benefits

  • Impact. You see your results in the real world, fast. The problems are concrete (production plans, capacities, logistics), and customers can measure in euros what your work changed.
  • Ownership. What you build, you ship, and you own it once it runs. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's.
  • The people next to you. You work directly with the CTO on the platform layer, and with the math and OR team on the optimization engine.
  • Shaping. The processes are still forming, and whoever shows up with a better way of doing things gets to install it. This is a place for system thinkers: the interesting part is seeing how the pieces fit and where they will break. The company is early, and your scope will grow with it.
  • Feedback speed. You will know where you stand. We say things out loud, we adjust, and we expect the same from you.
  • High stakes. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.
  • The basics. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.

Process: first conversation, 20 minutes, with me or with the engineer who owns our frontend. Second conversation with the two of us together; this is where the technical questions get deep. Then a hands-on challenge, about three hours of your time, followed by a 45-minute walkthrough where you explain your solution and the decisions behind it. Finally, the team: online first, then in person at the office. Both sides decide. Two to three weeks end to end, and you hear back within days after each step. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.

To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about your favorite system you have built, and one decision in it you would reverse today.

"Hustle the day, analyze at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

Your responsibilities

We're looking for Plato's first GTM Engineer: the person who brings RevOps to Plato as a discipline and builds our revenue engine as a product, not a ticket queue. Pipeline, conversion, and revenue per headcount are your metrics.
You're inheriting real infrastructure - HubSpot as our source of truth, a custom-built deal-scoring app, call intelligence via Grain, and company-wide AI access - but the layers underneath are still unbuilt: clean data, automated process, real forecasting rigor, AI-driven workflows. That's the job.
This is a team-of-one role that's essentially a sandbox: a direct line to the founders, a mandate to change how we work, and no playbook telling you what to build first. If you want to build the infrastructure behind a revenue engine from the ground up and see your own builds move real numbers, let's talk.
What you'll actually do:

  • Get the data foundation trustworthy: CRM hygiene, field governance, deduping, enrichment on create
  • Automate the revenue process: lead routing, SLAs, stage criteria, clean handoffs across teams
  • Build the pipeline generation stack: signal-based outbound (ICP scoring, enrichment waterfalls, orchestration) so effort goes into conversations, not list-building
  • Bring AI into daily workflows: call-intelligence automation, research agents, health/churn scoring
  • Get forecasting and reporting to a place leadership can steer from weekly
  • Make sure what you ship gets used: instrument adoption, train the team, iterate


Your qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on experience architecting a CRM like HubSpot from the ground up - how objects, properties, and data structure are set up - not just administering one that's already built
  • Practical, production experience with outbound/enrichment tooling (e.g. Clay or similar)
  • You've built with AI/LLMs - prompt design, agents, or AI-powered workflows - in real production work
  • Strong data rigor: you can read a funnel, spot where the data is dirty, and quantify the impact of a fix before you build it
  • You think in systems and sequencing, not tickets - and can defend your reasoning under real pushback

Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience as an early GTM-Ops/RevOps hire at another startup
  • Familiarity with our stack or similar: Grain, Sales Navigator-style outbound tooling
  • Comfort with unit economics (CAC, ACV, payback)
  • Experience with mid-market, multi-stakeholder B2B deal cycles


Why us?

You'd be Plato's first-ever GTM Engineer - not inheriting someone else's system, but building the one that doesn't exist yet, and introducing RevOps as a discipline at a company that's never had one. A direct line to the founders, real budget for tooling, and a mandate to change how the revenue team works, from day one. 
This is an individual contributor role today - you'll be doing the building yourself, not managing a team. If this function grows as Plato scales, you'd be the one shaping what it becomes, not stepping into a structure someone else already defined.
Because the function touches everything - data, process, automation, AI - you won't be boxed into one lane. If you want to see your own build move a real number within your first 90 days, this is that role.

data.title: Praktikant/ Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Group Transformation Team

data.description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Du wirst eingearbeitet, bevor du loslegst. Die ersten Wochen läufst du mit, schaust zu und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt. Erst wenn du sicher bist, bekommst du eigene Objekte — nicht am ersten Tag.
  • Du lernst den Markt an der schnellsten Stelle kennen. Vermietung ist der Bereich, in dem man am schnellsten versteht, wie Immobilien funktionieren: warum sich eine Wohnung in drei Tagen vermietet und die im selben Haus in sechs Wochen nicht.
  • Du sprichst selbst mit Kunden. Interessenten, Mieter, Eigentümer. Du bist vor Ort das Gesicht von LPE und nicht die Stimme im Hintergrund.
  • Du hast einen festen Ansprechpartner. Ein Makler aus dem Team begleitet dich, gibt dir Rückmeldung und übernimmt, wenn ein Fall komplizierter wird. Fragen zu stellen ist bei uns kein Zeichen von Schwäche, sondern Teil des Jobs.
  • Wir entwickeln unsere Makler selbst. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, hat nach dem Studium eine Perspektive.
  • Du arbeitest mit Software, die es sonst nicht gibt. Unser eigenes System lpeOS bildet Prozesse ab, für die andere Unternehmen noch mit Excel-Listen und Papierordnern arbeiten.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du organisierst die Vermarktung einer Einheit. Fototermin mit unseren Fotografen abstimmen und begleiten, Exposé erstellen, Inserat veröffentlichen und aktuell halten. Beim Exposé unterstützt dich unser Marketing.
  • Du kümmerst dich um die Interessenten. Anfragen sichten und vorqualifizieren, Termine koordinieren, Besichtigungen durchführen und nachfassen. Auch dann, wenn auf ein Objekt vierzig Anfragen kommen.
  • Du bereitest die Mieterauswahl vor. Unterlagen auf Vollständigkeit prüfen, Bonitätsnachweise sichten und deine Einschätzung zu den Bewerbern abgeben. Die finale Entscheidung trefft ihr gemeinsam.
  • Du unterstützt bei Abnahmen und Übergaben: Protokolle vorbereiten, Zählerstände erfassen, Mängel dokumentieren, Schlüssel übergeben.
  • Du hältst die Daten sauber. Jeder Kontakt, jeder Termin, jeder Status im System. Das klingt unspektakulär und ist die Grundlage dafür, dass bei uns nichts verloren geht.
  • Du arbeitest den Maklern zu. Termine vorbereiten, Objektunterlagen zusammenstellen, Korrespondenz übernehmen, bei Interessenten und Dienstleistern nachfassen. Vieles davon lernst du dabei nebenbei — weil du siehst, wie ein erfahrener Makler einen Fall aufbaut.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben. Stammdaten pflegen, Unterlagen digitalisieren und ablegen, Prozesse dokumentieren. Wie viel das ist, hängt von der Auslastung ab — planbar besprechen wir das jede Woche.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu. Eine Besichtigung mit acht fremden Leuten zu führen, muss dir liegen. Perfekt sein musst du dabei am Anfang nicht.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Menschen — oder willst es entwickeln. Bei der Mieterauswahl zählt nicht nur die Bonität, und genau dieses Urteil lernst du bei uns.
  • Du bist gut organisiert. Mehrere Objekte, Termine und Fristen parallel: Wer hier den Überblick verliert, verliert auch den guten Mieter.
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig. Interessenten stehen sonst vor verschlossener Tür, und das kostet uns beim Eigentümer mehr als jeder Fehler im Exposé.
  • Du fragst nach, statt zu raten — bei Kunden genauso wie im Team.
  • Du bist eingeschrieben oder suchst eine Teilzeitstelle. Die Studienrichtung ist zweitrangig, kaufmännisches oder immobilienwirtschaftliches Interesse hilft.
  • Du lernst Software schnell und denkst digital.

Vorerfahrung in der Immobilienbranche brauchst du nicht. Das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Einarbeitung. Du läufst mit, bekommst deine Aufgaben schrittweise und arbeitest ab dem ersten Tag mit jemandem zusammen, den du alles fragen kannst.
  • Aufgaben, die dich weiterbringen. Du machst keine Ablage und keine Kaffeeküche, sondern Arbeit, die im Lebenslauf etwas bedeutet und die du im nächsten Bewerbungsgespräch erklären kannst.
  • Perspektive nach dem Studium. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, bekommt eine Zukunft und nicht nur ein Zeugnis.
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig — und wir sorgen dafür, dass du die Aufgaben und die Unterstützung bekommst, die dich dorthin bringen.
  • Gelebte Feedback-Kultur. Feedback ist das schnellste Werkzeug, das wir haben, um besser zu werden. Deshalb geben wir es sofort und nicht einmal im Jahr. Das gilt in beide Richtungen: Du bekommst ehrliche Rückmeldung — und wir erwarten sie genauso von dir.
  • Planbarkeit im Semester. Vorlesungszeiten und Klausurphasen stimmen wir im Voraus ab, statt sie zum Problem zu machen. Besichtigungen liegen ohnehin häufig am späten Nachmittag.
  • Modernste Ausstattung: Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, papierlos.
  • e-Mobilität inklusive: internes E-Carsharing für Termine und private Erledigungen.

data.description:
Beam AI builds self-learning AI agents and an organisational operating system where intelligence grows through autonomous discovery. We help enterprises evolve from AI-curious to AI-native with automation that delivers results today and learns to improve itself over time. Join us in shaping a future where AI continuously discovers, adapts, and makes work more meaningful. To learn more, visit https://beam.ai/.

About the Team

Beam’s AI Agent Deployment team sits at the intersection of AI, product, and client impact. We partner closely with customers to understand their workflows, design intelligent automation solutions, and ensure our agents deliver real business value. Our work spans workflow design, agent configuration, technical integration, and ongoing optimization. We collaborate with engineering, ML, and product teams to translate abstract problems into scalable, agentic systems that work in the real world. This is a high-context, high-ownership environment where Deployment engineers operate with autonomy, move fast, and shape both how Beam’s platform evolves and how our customers succeed.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Agent Engineer at Beam, you will play a key role in delivering enterprise-grade AI automations tailored to real business processes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their requirements, break down complex workflows, and design prompt-driven agents that solve high-impact problems. You'll also support integration efforts with client systems and ensure smooth delivery from concept to deployment.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a hands-on, fast-moving environment, with a strong technical foundation, programming skills, a process-oriented mindset, and a passion for AI. You should feel confident working with APIs, designing robust automations, and collaborating across teams to turn business needs into working solutions. If you enjoy working across clients, technology, and automation, and want to build things that work in the real world, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

Your work will involve both prompt engineering excellence and close customer collaboration. You will be expected to:

  • Partner with enterprise customers to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and translate business problems into agent-powered solutions
  • Design and build agentic automations using Beam's Agent OS. This includes scoping workflows, engineering prompts, and configuring integrations
  • Manage delivery end-to-end: timelines, client expectations, and stakeholder communication across technical and executive audiences
  • Troubleshoot and iterate on live automations by diagnosing issues, refining prompts, and improving performance
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to scope features, surface platform gaps, and feed customer insights back into the roadmap
  • Act as a strategic advisor to clients on AI adoption, workflow automation best practices, and integration architecture

Requirements

  • 2-3 years in a client-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineer, Implementation Consultant, Deployment Engineer, Customer Engineer, or similar
  • Strong project management and communication skills. You can run delivery timelines, manage client expectations, and explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and executives
  • Demonstrated prompt engineering expertise. You've systematically written, tested, and optimized prompts in production or near-production settings
  • Experience automating workflows with AI. You've used AI to automate real business processes, not just experimented in sandboxes
  • Solid API knowledge and integration experience. You're comfortable scoping and coordinating API-based integrations with external systems
  • Analytical, process-driven thinking. You can take a messy business workflow, break it into structured components, and design an automation approach

Nice to Have

  • AI/ML background or hands-on experience applying AI to business workflows
  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment

How We Hire

  • Our process includes a case study where you'll work on a realistic automation challenge: designing an extraction prompt, building a project plan, and presenting your approach. We want to see how you think, not just what you know.

Benefits

At Beam, we’re building an environment where ambitious people can do their best work, with clarity, purpose, and room to grow. We’re thoughtful about what we build, how we work, and who we hire. The problems we’re solving are real. The systems we’re building are complex. And the people here care deeply, about craft, about speed, and about doing work that actually matters. You won’t find rigid hierarchies or endless process here. You’ll find high trust, high standards, and a team driven by curiosity, ownership, and long-term thinking.

Our culture is shaped by our values in action:

  • AI-native thinking: Every teammate thinks in agentic workflows, uses AI tools daily, and looks for leverage through automation. AI isn’t just what we build, it's how we operate.
  • Customer obsession: We build with urgency and empathy, speak to customers early and often, and measure success through their outcomes.
  • Speed as a habit: We ship fast, learn faster, and prioritise unblocking over perfection. We favour small experiments with tight feedback loops.
  • Leverage-focused execution: We hire high-impact players, invest in the 20% that drives 80% of results, and value candid feedback.
  • Highly aligned, loosely coupled: We align on outcomes, not tasks. You’ll work independently, but never in isolation.
  • Data-driven, human-guided: We seek clarity over comfort, speak up early, and use feedback to grow together.

If this sounds like the kind of work you want to do and the kind of team you want to grow with, we’d love to hear from you!

Genau da setzen wir an, mit einem modernen Produkt und KI-gestützten Funktionen, die Routinearbeit abnehmen statt sie nur zu digitalisieren.
KI ist bei uns kein Buzzword auf der Website, sondern Teil des Arbeitsalltags – im Produkt und in jedem Team. Auch im Marketing: Wir planen, produzieren und optimieren Content mit KI-Tools und schaffen dadurch als kleines Team deutlich mehr als klassische Marketingabteilungen.

Darum geht's in dieser Rolle
Für unser Marketing haben wir ein klares Konzept: Redaktionsplan, Content-Vorlagen und ein fester Outreach-Prozess für Instagram. Was wir suchen, ist jemand, der das zuverlässig umsetzt und am Laufen hält – Beiträge und Stories erstellen, täglich neue Accounts ansprechen, alles sauber dokumentieren.
Du bekommst also keine leere Seite, sondern eine Grundlage, mit der du sofort loslegen kannst. Und wenn du eigene Ideen hast, wie wir Content oder Outreach besser machen können: sehr gerne – wir sind offen dafür und probieren gemeinsam aus.
Perfekt, wenn du neben Studium oder Job praktische Marketing-Erfahrung sammeln willst – bei uns machst du nicht Kaffee, sondern echten Content, der rausgeht. Und du lernst nebenbei, wie moderne KI-Tools im Marketing wirklich eingesetzt werden.

  • Mitdenken erwünscht – Wenn dir auffällt, dass ein Format besser läuft als ein anderes oder ein Ablauf schneller ginge: raus damit, wir setzen es gemeinsam um

Qualifikation

  • Du bist zuverlässig und strukturiert – tägliche Routineaufgaben sind für dich kein Problem, sondern dein Ding

Direct influence on the brand, product and company from the beginning.

Real merchants, strong early traction and a pre-seed round already raised.

An ambitious, high-intensity, in-person environment in Bonn with a team that takes health, trust and good intent seriously.

Right now, we’re building across AI, consumer products and services, with our biggest current focus on a service helping brands understand and improve how they show up in AI recommendations.

You’d be building the media presence behind all of it, starting with the founder’s own.

  • Grow the presence of the founder (Eli) and our brands, primarily across LinkedIn and Instagram

We’d rather understand how you think and what you have good taste in.

What is Jedox?

Jedox is a global leader in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and a recognized Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, helping organizations transform fragmented planning into connected, data-driven decision-making.

Trusted by more than 2,500 customers worldwide, Jedox enables business planning, budgeting and forecasting for finance, sales, and broader enterprise departments with leading-edge technology to outperform digital transformation and provide tangible customer value. At the heart of the platform is JedoxAI - a multi-agent intelligence engine delivering explainable, AI-powered forecasting, natural-language insights and AIssisted™ planning - putting Jedox at the forefront of the shift to AI-driven performance management.


Your Responsibilities

As a Sales Account Executive (m/f/d) within the Jedox team, you will play a key part in helping enterprise customers to transform their planning, forecasting and performance management processes. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will use a value-based sales approach to show how Jedox provides modern, digital and integrated enterprise performance and analysis (xP&A) solutions.

In this role, you will own the entire sales process for enterprise customers, from identifying potential clients to closing deals. You will promote Jedox as the ideal solution for xP&A initiatives, work closely with internal teams and develop long-term relationships with customers and partners, while maintaining a strong focus on value, trust and sustainable success.

We are building a high-performing team defined by ownership, accountability and energy. This is a genuinely exciting time to join: AI is reshaping how every finance team plans and forecasts, and Jedox is right at the centre of that conversation - giving you a fresh, differentiated story to take to market. If you're a motivated seller who enjoys being out in front of customers and partners, and want to make your mark in an exciting company, you'll find real support, momentum and opportunity here. You will own your number, your territory and your pipeline - creating opportunity rather than waiting for it, with a team around you that celebrates the wins together.

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle: Generate revenue by adopting a value-selling approach throughout the process, from initial engagement to closing enterprise-level deals - with full personal accountability for every outcome in your territory.
  • Create and own high-quality pipeline: Build and maintain healthy pipeline coverage against your quota through proactive, self-generated prospecting - not just inbound - with disciplined weekly pipeline management in our CRM as the single source of truth.
  • Communicate the value of Jedox: Demonstrate how Jedox and JedoxAI empower xP&A projects and elevate planning, forecasting and business decisions - bringing AI-driven, explainable forecasting into the conversation and anchoring every discussion on business outcomes, not features.
  • Inspire digital transformation: Engage prospects by presenting a clear and compelling vision of digitisation and integrated business planning.
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Identify, prospect and execute targeted sales plays and activities to win enterprise customers, including structured account planning, rigorous qualification (e.g. MEDDPICC) and multi-threading across finance, IT and operations stakeholders.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Acquire new customers by working closely with the pre-sales, channel management, marketing and business development teams - bringing colleagues and partners in early, and lifting each other up as one team with one number.
  • Drive market-facing activity: Contribute to workshops, webinars and events alongside marketing and partners to create demand and build visible expertise in your market.
  • Work smarter with AI: Actively use modern AI tools in your daily workflow - from account research and prospecting to preparing presentations, proposals and follow-ups - so more of your time goes where it counts: in front of customers and partners.
  • Own forecasting and pipeline management: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts as well as pipeline reports, with strong CRM hygiene, and play an active role in prospecting activities.
  • Build lasting relationships: Build trusted partnerships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to ensure long-term success.


Your Profile

  • Over three years' experience in professional sales, ideally within the FP&A function.
  • Experience in Enterprise Performance Management or in selling analytics, AI, data, or ERP solutions.
  • Strong record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals.
  • Proven ability to build, manage and self-generate a healthy sales pipeline and expand existing accounts.
  • A high-ownership mindset: you act with urgency, take responsibility for your results, and when challenges arise you come with ideas on how to tackle them together.
  • Resilience and positivity: you're the kind of person who stays positive, keeps going and enjoys the journey as much as the win.
  • A love of being active in the market: you genuinely enjoy talking to customers and partners - on calls, in meetings and at events - and you know that's where great pipeline comes from.
  • Strong collaboration skills with a clear focus on customer success and innovation.
  • Confident, hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar) in your day-to-day selling - for example researching accounts, building presentations and business cases, sharpening messaging and working smarter across the sales cycle.
  • Native or fluent English skills; an established network and knowledge of the UK & Ireland enterprise market are a real advantage.

SumUp recently invested in a full brand refresh, giving the business a distinctive new voice with real momentum behind it. Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

Join us as we work to unlock the value of offshore wind! JERA Nex bp is a new joint venture between JERA, Japan’s largest power generation company, and bp, one of the world’s leading energy companies. Established to unlock the potential of offshore wind across the globe, our talented team, exciting pipeline and solid capital commitment give us the potential to become one of the world’s most successful offshore wind companies. 

We entered the market with a portfolio of operational and development assets, alongside the resources, capabilities and resilience to deliver offshore wind energy at scale. 

 

Why this role matters 

You will join the Accounting team and be part of the wider Finance department of JERA Nex bp. The team is made up of approximately 16 people working to deliver high quality and efficient accounting on a local standalone as well as consolidated group level for a multinational organisation.

Why you should join us:

  • Dynamic and experienced team with various backgrounds

  • Motivated to support JERA Nex bp’s offshore wind ambitions

  • Exposed to international deployment of renewable energy at a critical time for the energy transition

In this role you will: 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to take full ownership of end-to-end accounting for a portfolio of legal entities within the group. This is a hands-on, "a-z" role covering everything from transactional processing through statutory reporting and audit management.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end accounting for assigned legal entities, including invoice posting/payments, accruals, month-end close and reconciliations

  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.

  • Manage intercompany accounting, funding transactions, and acquisition-related bookkeeping

  • Ensure compliance with tax regulations and assist in the preparation of tax returns.

  • Support transfer pricing documentation and calculations

  • Perform payroll accounting and service invoice creation

  • Manage accounts receivable, cash management, and liquidity planning

  • Prepare UK statutory financial statements (UK GAAP) and support IFRS group reporting

  • Lead statutory audit management and support group audit requirements

  • Identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities within the accounting function

  • Implement and maintain effective internal controls.


To be successful in the role you will bring: 

  • Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a comparable professional qualification (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CIMA)

  • 10+ years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SAP S/4HANA

  • Solid working knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Strong problem-solving ability and a proactive approach to process improvement/automation

  • Experience with VAT and CIT processes in a UK context is essential; transfer pricing exposure a plus

  • Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy

  • Strong ethical standards and integrity.

What you can expect from us: 

Working at JERA Nex bp means being part of a global leader in offshore wind, where innovation, collaboration, and sustainability drive everything we do. You’ll enjoy: 

  • A collaborative and inclusive work culture, with space for team-building and social activities 

  • Flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home, with regular in-person connection 

  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development in a fast-growing international company. 

 

As we build our company, we are driven by:  

Care for each other and our world – we leave egos at the door, are inclusive, collaborative and open to new ideas 

A spirit of ingenuity - we are pioneers and innovators making the impossible possible 

A commitment to unlocking value from offshore wind – we aim to make offshore wind sustainable, affordable and accessible to the countries & communities we serve. 

 

About JERA Nex bp 

JERA Nex bp is a purpose-built offshore wind company committed to unlocking the power of offshore wind by developing high-quality, competitive projects. 

A 50:50 joint venture between JERA Co. and bp, JERA Nex bp is an end-to-end developer, owner and operator with more than fifteen years of experience in operating offshore wind projects.  

Headquartered in London, with offices across Europe, Asia, and Australia, JERA Nex bp has a portfolio of operational and development projects across nine countries, and draws on a rich heritage of pioneering offshore wind in Asia Pacific and the North Sea.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

Your Role

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

This is a fast-paced learning environment where you will execute the end-to-end User Acquisition process, from campaign setup and creative iteration to data analysis and reporting. You will have autonomy in your day-to-day execution, with continuous guidance and feedback from the team and senior leadership to accelerate your growth. Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Execution and Scaling Support:

  • Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

  • Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

  • Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

  • Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

  • Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards

Creative & Funnel Contribution:

  • Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

  • Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

  • Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue

Partnership Management & Learning:

  • Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

Challenges You’ll Tackle

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

  • Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

  • Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

  • Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset

⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows
